detail: Serena MCP pattern proven: in-process HTTP server, vanilla frontend, polling updates. Native http module avoids Express dependency. Cytoscape.js (109KB) and vis-timeline (186KB) are mature, zero-framework graph/timeline libraries. No build step required for frontend.
summary: Embedded HTTP dashboard using native Node.js http module, vanilla HTML/JS, cytoscape.js for graph, vis-timeline for timeline
